name: Data Analyzer: README does not offer the agent-to-agent routes as available
objective: Proves the main README does not tell readers they can call agent-to-agent (A2A) web routes that are not part of the released service.
precondition: The project's own documentation files are present in the repository. Nothing is run; the test only reads the text of the files.

steps.expected: The phrase for the A2A example request line (a POST to the data-analyzer agent route) does not appear anywhere
The sentence saying these routes are 'not copied into the released' service is present

name: Data Analyzer: Integration guide has no instructions to expose the service without authentication
objective: Proves the integration guide does not show an open, unauthenticated call to the agent-to-agent port and instead warns that the service must not be exposed without authentication.
precondition: The project's own documentation files are present in the repository. Nothing is run; the test only reads the text of the files.

steps.expected: The example 'curl' command that posts to the agent route on port 8003 over plain HTTP does not appear

steps.action: Check for the warning, with line breaks ignored
steps.expected: The text says the service must never be exposed to a network without authentication

name: Data Analyzer: Azure deployment README forbids unguarded update commands and names the guard script
objective: Proves the Azure Container Apps deployment guide does not tell people to run raw create/update commands and directs them to the approved guard script instead.
precondition: The project's own documentation files are present in the repository. Nothing is run; the test only reads the text of the files.

steps.expected: Neither a raw 'az containerapp update --name' nor a raw 'az containerapp create --name' command appears

steps.action: Check the guard script and the Deploy section
steps.expected: The guard script name 'aca-guard.sh' appears in the file, and the Deploy section contains no home-directory path (no '~/')

name: Data Analyzer: Docs state that the interactive API pages are open without an API key by design
objective: Proves the README and integration guide both record the deliberate decision that the automatically generated API description pages need no API key.
precondition: The project's own documentation files are present in the repository. Nothing is run; the test only reads the text of the files.

steps.expected: README.md contains the sentence 'open without an API key by design'; INTEGRATION.md contains the same wording (split across two lines)
